calibration_design.scope: Synthetic longitudinal, aligned regular time courses. Lasso native CV/default stability panels use 10,25,50 genes and sufficient biological series; the separately labelled reduced-stability branch covers 50,100,200 genes. Finite registered shapes, named parameters and TF policy only; other values and interactions remain unvalidated. Assigned RAM is a limit, not a measured memory-use model. Serial backends do not gain CPU scaling from extra assigned cores.

validation_policy.genes: strict integer midpoints of each registered adjacent gene level; no temporal shape interpolation
validation_policy.fixed_gene_profiles: Timing points only; no independent interpolation claim.
